title: plugin-security: the per-variant officer cases in org-admin-assignment-boundary.posture.test.ts hit vitest's 5000 ms default on a loaded Test Core shard
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Ca1jJvsA1dHsPwMiQb

Area: data-1 · found on PR #35386 (#35167), measured in 7004581195 and 7004622123

## 维护者速读
- **问题：** 一组权限测试在 CI 负载高的时候会超时，跟改动无关，却让别的 PR 一直是红的。
- **要做：** 给这组测试定一个实测的时间预算，或把每个测试的工作量拆小。
- **不做会怎样：** 改到写入路径的 PR 会因为这组测试反复变红、没法合入。
- **你要做的：** 无。

## What
The 12 "adding and removing a holder" cases (2 postures × 6 callers) in `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/org-admin-assignment-boundary.posture.test.ts` (around :1153) take about 0.5 s each locally. On loaded Test Core shards today, the shards that also run scenarios, service-messaging and verify, they took 2 to 5.5 s:
- main scheduled run 44484542279: 3217 ms;
- PR #35383 run 44480050457: 4705 ms;
- PR #35386: 5534 ms, then two timeouts on the re-run.

The whole file takes 75 to 179 s on CI. For every variant, each case does a grant insert, a removal by id, a bulk removal and a position holding.

## Fix
Fix the time budget, not the assertions. Either declare a measured per-case budget with its class (the AGENTS.md suite-weight rule), or split the per-variant loop so each case does less work. Do not raise the global `testTimeout`, and do not skip anything.

## Done when
The file's cases carry a declared, measured budget (or are split), with the measurement recorded. PR #35386 goes green after this lands and main is merged in.

Blocks: #35386 (PR of #35167).

Grade: `area:data · Bug (test infra) · reach: any PR whose Test Core shard is loaded · evidence: measured` → p2 (takes the grade of what it blocks).
